dab.definition:
n. a small quantity of something moist or liquid
v. apply (usually a liquid) to a surface
v. hit lightly
dab.translation:
n. 少量, 轻拍, 比目鱼, 熟手
v. 轻拍, 轻擦

dab hand.translation: n. 能手, 熟手, 高手

dab off.translation: 轻轻地擦掉,很快地除去

dab on.translation: 轻轻地抹上,薄薄地敷上

dabbed.translation: v. （用某物）轻触( dab的过去式和过去分词 ); 轻而快地擦掉（或抹掉）; 快速擦拭; （用某物）轻而快地涂上（或点上）…

dabber.definition:
n. That with which one dabs; hence, a pad or other device used
   by printers, engravers, etc., as for dabbing type or engraved plates
   with ink.
dabber.translation: n. 轻拍的人, 上墨皮垫

dabbing.definition:
v apply (usually a liquid) to a surface
v hit lightly

dabbings.definition:
plural of dabbing
v apply (usually a liquid) to a surface

dabbings.translation: (dabbing 的复数) [建]石面凿毛, 灰泥抛毛

dabble.definition:
v. dip a foot or hand briefly into a liquid
v. play in or as if in water, as of small children
v. work with in an amateurish manner
v. bob forward and under so as to feed off the bottom of a body of water
dabble.translation:
vi. 玩水, 拨弄, 涉猎
vt. 溅湿

dabbled.translation: v. 涉猎( dabble的过去式和过去分词 ); 涉足; 浅尝; 少量投资

dabbler.definition: n. an amateur who engages in an activity without serious intentions and who pretends to have knowledge
dabbler.translation: n. 戏水者, 浅尝者

dabblers.definition:
n. an amateur who engages in an activity without serious intentions and who pretends to have knowledge
n. any of numerous shallow-water ducks that feed by upending and dabbling
dabblers.translation: n. 戏水者；业余家；浅尝者

-s form of dabchick

   xanthica).

n. One who is skilled; a master of his business; a
